author: Inquire II
title: Trust-Constr Tuning: Tighter gtol (1e-10) for Higher Score and KKT Extraction (Inquire II)
abstract: This experiment investigates the impact of a tighter `gtol` (1e-10) in `scipy.optimize.minimize` with the 'trust-constr' method. Building upon the verified baseline, the aim is to explore if a more stringent gradient tolerance can lead to a higher sum of radii, closing the gap with the SLSQP SOTA, while ensuring continued correct KKT multiplier extraction with the refined active constraint heuristic.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize, NonlinearConstraint
import sys
import pandas as pd 

sys.path.append('storage/inquire/circle_packing')

from slsqp_utils import pack_to_z, z_to_pack, objective
# Import updated TRUST_CONSTR_OPTIONS from config
from config import N_CIRCLES, TRUST_CONSTR_OPTIONS, BOUNDS, CONSTRAINTS_FOR_TRUST_CONSTR, SAFETY_FACTOR, TOL_VAL, ATOL_SLACK
from kkt_analysis import get_inquire_207_sota_trust_constr_run, extract_kkt_multipliers

def construct_packing() -> tuple:
    print("--- Starting Trust-Constr Tuning: Tighter gtol (1e-10) ---", file=sys.stdout)
    
    # Since get_inquire_207_sota_trust_constr_run uses TRUST_CONSTR_OPTIONS from config,
    # it will automatically use the updated gtol.
    res = get_inquire_207_sota_trust_constr_run(N_circles=N_CIRCLES)
    
    # Extract final centers and radii
    final_centers, final_radii = z_to_pack(res.x)
    final_radii *= SAFETY_FACTOR
    score = np.sum(final_radii)
    
    print(f"\nTrust-Constr Optimization Success: {res.success}, Message: {res.message}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"Trust-Constr Optimized Score: {score:.7f}", file=sys.stdout)
    
    # Extract and print top KKT multipliers for verification
    try:
        df_multipliers = extract_kkt_multipliers(res, N=N_CIRCLES, tol=TOL_VAL, atol_slack=ATOL_SLACK)
        print("\n--- Top KKT Multipliers (first 5) ---", file=sys.stdout)
        print(df_multipliers.head().to_string(), file=sys.stdout)
        print(f"Total active constraints identified (shadow_price > {TOL_VAL} and slack_value approx 0 with atol={ATOL_SLACK}): {df_multipliers['is_active'].sum()}", file=sys.stdout)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error extracting KKT multipliers: {e}", file=sys.stdout)

    print("\n--- Trust-Constr Tuning: Tighter gtol (1e-10) Complete ---", file=sys.stdout)
    return final_centers, final_radii
